execution_record.command_note: The script contains no argparse and accepts no arguments; this is its documented canonical invocation. Its data paths are derived from __file__, so the result is independent of the working directory.
execution_record.working_directory: <repository root> (mounted as $HOME/mnt/research-test-2 in the audit VM)
execution_record.capture_method: Shell redirection of stdout and stderr to separate files in the verification directory. The script additionally performs its OWN write to /tmp/sens_out.txt at line 150 (Path(...).write_text), which is a script-controlled write and not a shell redirection; that file was copied into the verification directory unmodified after the run. The script's P() helper both appends to an in-memory list and prints, so the two captures are expected to carry the same content.
script_side_effects: Creates /tmp/sens_out.txt inside the execution VM (outside the repository). No pre-existing file was overwritten: /tmp/sens_out.txt was verified absent before the run.

preserved_outputs.content: verbatim copy of the file the script itself wrote to /tmp/sens_out.txt

capture_consistency_check.stdout_vs_script_written_file: IDENTICAL except that the script-written file has no trailing newline on its final line (6923 vs 6924 bytes). diff reports exactly one difference, '\ No newline at end of file'.
capture_consistency_check.conclusion: Either capture is a complete record of the run's reported output.

configuration_as_read_from_source.governance_mappings_note: Lines 61-63 freeze FULL/RESTRICTED/EMPTY and the C1 and C2 admissible-set tables. The script's own docstring states that A_AI(CAUTION) = {Go, Delay} is frozen and only environmental classification thresholds vary.
configuration_as_read_from_source.shared_g_t_note: Line 13 imports g_t and is_daylight from scripts/canonical_gt.py; no solar astronomy is embedded in the sensitivity script.
configuration_as_read_from_source.marine_warning_component: held at SAFE for all rows (line 39), the declared exclusion D = {m}

results_produced_by_this_run.all_manuscript_sensitivity_values_produc: 7 of 8 produced directly in the output; the 56-combination count is not printed by the script and was established by static enumeration of the script's configuration literals, not by the run.
results_produced_by_this_run.printed_precision: 2 decimal places for all percentages; the script's format specifiers are .2f. Underlying float values are not recoverable from the preserved output.

limitations: This run does not recreate the September 2026 execution environment. Only the pandas and numpy versions are known to match; the historical Python minor version, OS and architecture are UNKNOWN.

The script prints percentages at 2 decimal places. Sub-0.01-point agreement with the historical run cannot be observed from the preserved output, and the historical output no longer exists for byte comparison.

The 56-combination count is not emitted by the script. It was derived by static enumeration of the script's own configuration literals, which requires one interpretive step (see the verification report, section E).
The exclusive component attribution printed by this run (518 / 13 for PRIMARY) was outside this task's verification scope and is recorded but not verified here.
No other canonical script was executed. The headline experiment, the attribution analysis and the figure generation remain unexecuted by this task.
